why: round_lips gives 0-6.6 cm2 of opening, so a full seal is possible for /p/ with the tongue lowered (airway about 1 cm2 elsewhere). With max_protrusion 1.6 cm the lip tube can grow to 2.6 cm, which lengthens the front cavity and narrows the outlet. That should pull F2 from about 1070-1140 down toward 840-1020 and bring /u/ F1 down from 418 to about 300. No params move can do this: the closure floor is fixed by the cast lip shape.

tip_tongue's blade slides 0.3-5 cm behind the teeth and can seal, which gives /t/. Setting the body stroke to 1.3 (above 1.2) lets the pad shut the velar region, which gives /k/. No value of rail_start (minimum 2.5 cm) reaches the alveolar place, so a params move cannot fix /t/. The second constriction may also start moving /ɝ/ F3 down from its 2770 Hz floor.
